data.body: Phase 1 retroactive review progress: PR #193 ci.yml deterministic checks GREEN after .test-index split fix (commit e1a6cd152a). New per-branch-review.yml run 26003224816 in progress against the 7947-line retroactive diff; prior run 26002790463 FAILED on 'schema correction exhausted all 2 attempts' due to diff size exceeding the 1500-line threshold. Waiting on run + ci.yml's llm-review job (PR #188 catch-net) to see if either path produces a usable LLM review on a diff this large. If both struggle, will split the retroactive scope into multiple smaller PRs.
